description: This file contains utility functions for managing tenant selection and session state in a web application frontend. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs, get/set/clear the active tenant in localStorage, fetch authorized tenants from the server, and select a tenant via server API calls. The code is designed for a browser environment and is part of a tenant routing feature to scope user data appropriately.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId(t)
methods.description: Extracts a tenant ID from various possible structures, converting it to a string or returning null if not found.

methods.name: getActiveTenant()
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from localStorage, with fallback to legacy key for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: setActiveTenant(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in localStorage, ensuring legacy key cleanup.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant()
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from localStorage by calling setActiveTenant with null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants()
methods.description: Fetches the list of tenants authorized for the current session from the backend API.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user-selection')
methods.description: Sets the active tenant by calling the backend API, updates localStorage, and performs client-side validation and error handling.
